message.content: {"title":"AERO9500 Final Report (Part 2) – Space Mission Design","overview":"Design a preliminary space mission benefiting Australia and present its space segment (launch, orbit, ground segment, operations, EOL) in a technical report, supported by mission-design software and hand calculations.","deliverables":["Single PDF technical report submitted via Turnitin on Moodle","Relevant screenshots included in report or appendix","All relevant STK or PIGI files included with report or appendix"],"format":{"length":"Maximum 20 pages for core report (excluding title page, table of contents, references, etc.)","structure":"Executive summary; Introduction (mission overview and rationale); Main body covering space segment (launch, orbit, ground stations, coverage, mission operation, end-of-life); Conclusion; Bibliography","other":"Clear, effective engineering-report writing style; correct grammar and spelling; clear and logical structure; figures and tables fully and correctly labelled (figure number, title, reference if necessary); all non-original text, diagrams and ideas identified and properly cited/referenced; Wikipedia not accepted as a proper source; report checked for plagiarism"},"requirements":[{"id":"R1","text":"Define the spacecraft's primary mission."},{"id":"R2","text":"State whether one or multiple spacecraft will be used."},{"id":"R3","text":"Identify the users, including operator and customers."},{"id":"R4","text":"Specify the launch site and launch vehicle."},{"id":"R5","text":"Define the orbit type, its characteristics and orbital elements."},{"id":"R6","text":"Identify any required orbital maneuvers."},{"id":"R7","text":"Identify ground control facilities and state how often the spacecraft can communicate with ground control."},{"id":"R8","text":"State the mission duration and end-of-life (EOL) plans."},{"id":"R9","text":"Ensure the mission benefits Australia in some way and keep the mission concept simple."},{"id":"R10","text":"Complete the design using software of choice (STK, PIGI, or other approved software such as flightclub after contacting Naomi), supplementing with hand calculations as needed."},{"id":"R11","text":"If using PIGI, register for the Saber Astronautics competition to obtain a software license; the design may be entered in the competition."},{"id":"R12","text":"Contact Naomi before starting work with software other than STK or PIGI."},{"id":"R13","text":"Include relevant screenshots and all relevant STK or PIGI files with the report or in the appendix."},{"id":"R14","text":"Cover all main-body space segment topics: launch, orbit, ground stations, coverage, mission operation and end-of-life."},{"id":"R15","text":"Fully and correctly label figures and tables with number, title and reference if necessary."},{"id":"R16","text":"Clearly identify and properly cite/reference all text, diagrams, ideas or other information not originating with the student; do not use Wikipedia as a proper source."}]}
